name: AI Publisher – AI Content Generator
author: kamenint

sections.description:
AI Publisher – One-Click, 80 + SEO WordPress Content Automation

Personalized, Unique, Authentic blog posting.

Stop juggling writers, image tools, and social schedulers. AI Publisher folds your entire publishing pipeline into a single WordPress plugin. One click delivers a long-form post, custom featured image, and ready-to-share updates for LinkedIn, Facebook, and X, before your coffee cools.

Features

  • Full Post Generation – Automatically generate personalized, authentic and unique blog posts (1500 – 2000 words) directly in your WordPress dashboard, AI Publisher handles content strategy, keyword research, structure, drafting, QA, and brand‑voice alignment in a single click
  • Automated Content Workflow – From content strategy and keyword research to full post drafting, QA, image generation, publishing, and social sharing, all in one WordPress plugin
  • Content Strategy Builder – Define brand purpose, tone, audience, values, mission, USP and more. AI Publisher strictly follows your guidelines
  • SEO & LLM Optimization – AI‑driven keyword research, structured headings, internal linking, FAQPage schema and 80+ SEO benchmark scores
  • Built-In FAQPage Schema – Automatically adds FAQ structured data to boost SEO with Google rich results and helps your content get indexed and surfaced by AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and other LLMs
  • Multi‑Step Quality Assurance – Drafts are automatically reviewed and refined for structure, accuracy, style and brand voice before publishing
  • Featured Image Generation – Automatically create, compress and SEO‑optimize a unique DALL·E image for each post
  • Flexible Scheduling & Publishing – Choose manual, suggested‑topic, or fully automated mode; schedule up to 24 posts/day (70/week)
  • One‑Click Social Sharing Prep – Generate optimized, editable post previews for LinkedIn, Facebook, and X (Twitter)
  • Zero Topic Overlap – Scans your site to ensure each generated post is unique, avoiding duplicate topics
  • Manual or AI‑Suggested Topics – Choose your own topic or let the AI suggest ideas with associated keywords
  • OpenAI API based Agents – Uses your own OpenAI key for content and image generation; cost-efficient (~$0.08/post)
  • Family‑Safe Filters – Automatically blocks generation in restricted topics (adult, gambling, alcohol, LGBT)
  • English‑Only Output (More Languages Coming) – Currently supports English content creation; multilingual support on the roadmap

Why Site Owners Install AI Publisher

– Proven 80 + SEO scores – posts routinely hit the 80% range on leading SEO benchmarks, giving you an instant visibility edge.
– End-to-end automation – keyword research, drafting, multi-step QA, content strategy, featured imagery, scheduling, and social promotion all happen inside AI Publisher, no extra tools needed.
– Brand-safe content – lock tone, audience, and value props with the built-in Content Strategy Builder, every paragraph stays on-message.
– Scales on autopilot – schedule up to 24 posts per day or 70 per week, or stick with manual one-click creation for flagship articles.
– True WordPress workflow – New posts drop into the correct category, come pre-tagged, and, depending on your settings, either wait for review or publish automatically.

How the “One Click” Works

  1. Strategy & Gap Analysis – AI pulls your saved content strategy, scans every post, page, category, and tag, then runs keyword research to spot high-value gaps while blocking duplicates.
  2. AI Draft + Multi-Step QA – A 1500 – 2000-word article is written in your voice, title, excerpt, categories, and tags included, then an automated QA agent checks originality, SEO, LLMO, structure, and brand alignment before finalizing.
  3. Featured Image & Metadata – A custom featured image is generated and set automatically; SEO title, meta description, and FAQPage schema markup are filled in behind the scenes.
  4. Publish or Review – Depending on your Scheduling Interval and default status, the post either goes live on schedule or lands in Draft/Pending for human review.
  5. Generate Share-Ready Posts – Use the built-in Promote Content screen for quick social snippets. Free users will see an upgrade notice.

Requirements

– A live WordPress site with pages and categories (posts optional).
– An active OpenAI API key to unlock the latest reasoning models.
– English output only (multilingual support on the roadmap).

Built-In Safeguards

– Family-safe filter blocks adult, gambling, alcohol, and similar topics.
– Smart caps prevent overload: 24 posts per day or 70 per week in automatic mode.

Try It Free

Start with a 7-day free trial or the Free tier (one AI post per week, strategy planner, keyword generator). Cancel anytime, no risk, no lock-in.

Ready to turn WordPress into a fully automated publishing engine? Install AI Publisher today and ship your next SEO and LLM-ready article before your coffee gets cold.

External services

AI Publisher connects to the OpenAI API to generate text, topics, and DALL·E images.
When you start a content strategy, topic suggestion, or post generation, the plugin sends publicly available site content (posts, pages, categories, and tags) and your saved strategy settings and SEO keywords to OpenAI’s servers. The data is used solely to create the requested output.

Service provider: OpenAI – Terms of Use, Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ai-publisher directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to AI Publisher -> Settings and enter your OpenAI API key.
sections.faq:
How does AI Publisher generate content?

It references your saved content strategy, analyzes existing posts, runs AI keyword research, then writes a complete post, title, excerpt, categories, tags, and body, before a built-in QA agent polishes it.

Is the content original and SEO/LLM-optimized?

Yes. Every article is drafted from scratch, checked for originality, and optimized for target keywords, on-page SEO, and large-language-model consumption.

Can I customize the brand voice and messaging?

Absolutely. Define tone, audience, messaging pillars, and more in the Content Strategy Builder, the AI follows those rules for every post and social share.

How does the plugin perform keyword research?

An AI SEO agent reviews your site data and brand info to suggest high-value keywords. You can add, remove, or edit any keyword at any time.

Will it duplicate existing topics on my site?

No. AI Publisher cross-checks all current posts, pages, categories, and tags to avoid covering the same topic twice.

Can I manually edit or guide what the AI writes?

Yes. Choose instant generation, AI-suggested topics, or start with your own topic and keywords, then edit any part of the draft before publishing.

How does the quality-assurance process work?

A multi-step QA agent verifies title relevance, SEO and LLM structure, keyword use, originality, brand voice, and formatting, revising issues automatically.

Does the plugin generate images for posts?

Yes. After drafting, it creates a custom featured image via DALL·E, adds it to your Media Library, and sets it as the post’s featured image.

Can I schedule automatic content publishing?

Yes. Set a daily or weekly schedule (up to 24 posts per day / 70 per week) or switch to manual mode for full control.

What are the OpenAI API costs per post?

Roughly $0.08 per post — about $0.06 for the image and $0.02 for the article. Actual cost varies with length and image detail.

How long does it take to generate a post?

Around five minutes for content, image, and QA, prioritizing quality over raw speed.

Which social media platforms are supported for sharing?

LinkedIn, Facebook, and X (Twitter).

Can I edit social posts before sharing?

Yes. Generated snippets are fully editable before you copy or publish them.

How does the plugin integrate with existing WordPress content?

It reads your posts, pages, categories, and tags to ensure new content is relevant, on-structure, and fills topical gaps.

Is there a limit to posts generated per day?

Automatic mode caps output at 24 posts per day or 70 per week; manual mode has no limit.

Are there any content restrictions?

Yes. The plugin blocks content related to adult entertainment, gambling, liquor, or LGBT topics.

Will it work with Yoast or Rank Math?

Yes. AI Publisher follows SEO and LLM best practices and remains fully compatible with popular SEO plugins.

Do I still need a human editor?

AI Publisher reduces manual effort, but a human review can add nuance and accommodate specialized topics.

How does the plugin keep content personalized?

It applies your content strategy at draft time and verifies alignment during QA before anything is published.

What happens if the AI makes a mistake?

You can review and edit every draft; nothing is published without your approval.

Do I need my own OpenAI API key?

Yes. Using your own key grants full control over usage and keeps your data private.

Does the plugin support multiple languages?

Currently English only; additional languages are on the roadmap.
